blocks.title: Stack
blocks.text: A stack is a data structure in which items are added and removed only at one end, called the top. It follows the Last-In, First-Out (LIFO) principle: the most recently added item is the first to be removed.

blocks.prompt: Define a stack and explain the LIFO principle (short question 3).
blocks.explanation: A stack is a collection where insertion (push) and deletion (pop) happen only at the top. LIFO means the last item pushed is the first popped, like a pile of plates where you take the top plate, the one put there last.

items: Stack: one open end (top); Last-In, First-Out.
